content.value: Determine the horse power required to drive a centrifugal pump which delivers 40 litres of water per second to a height of 20 m through a 100 mm diameter and 102 m long pipeline. The overall efficiency of the pump is 56% and Darcy's f = 0.03 for the pipe line. Assume inlet losses in suction pipe is equal to 0.4 m.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2019
